CustomField.description: Boolean formula that returns TRUE when this gift is in the Major band — either its own CurrentAmount meets or exceeds Major.One_Time_Min_Amount__c, or (installment inheritance) its parent GiftCommitment.ExpectedTotalCmtAmount meets or exceeds Major.Lifetime_Min_Amount__c. The top band is unbounded. The three gift checkboxes (Entry / Mid / Major) are mutually exclusive — at most one is TRUE for any gift. Installment inheritance: a payment against a large commitment inherits the commitment's grouping, so a $100 payment against a $100k commitment is a Major gift. Thresholds are configured via Setup → Custom Metadata Types → FQS Donor Grouping or the FQS Setup screen flow. Changing threshold values recalculates this field across all Gift Transaction records retroactively — no redeployment or batch job required.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated. The field is checked when this gift's amount qualifies for the Major donor grouping, or when it is an installment payment against a Major-grouping commitment. Your administrator controls the threshold amounts.
CustomField.label: Is Major Gift
